questions.originalSentence: The first five national parks, officially ______ (establish) in 2021, cover 230,000 square kilometers and protect nearly 30% of the country’s key wildlife species.
questions.passage: Over the past five years, China has made great progress in building its national park system. The first five national parks, officially ______ (establish) in 2021, cover 230,000 square kilometers and protect nearly 30% of the country’s key wildlife species. These parks have joined over 120 nature reserves together, greatly improving ecosystem health and long-term ______ (stable). Each park plays a special role. The Sanjiangyuan National Park protects the sources of three major rivers, having increased their water flow ______ nearly 50% in the past five years. The Giant Panda National Park connects separate panda habitats, giving the animals a larger and ______ (safe) home. In the Northeast Tiger and Leopard National Park, the number of wild tigers ______ (grow) from 27 to about 70 since 2017. The Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park is the only place ______ the Hainan gibbon population has been steadily rising. Wuyishan National Park ______ (hold) the world’s most complete mid-subtropical forest ecosystem at its latitude. The parks also benefit local people: nearly 50,000 residents have found park-related jobs near their homes, ______ (earn) 10,000—20,000 yuan yearly. In August 2024, China completed property rights registration for these parks, clarifying ownership ______ responsibilities. A new national park law will take effect on January 1, 2026, providing strong legal protection for these natural ______ (treasure).

blanks.trapAnalysis: 此处为非谓语动词作后置定语修饰 national parks，national parks 与 establish 之间是被动关系，故用过去分词 established。
